title: Evaluation Rubric
summary: Skill 出力の forward-test 採点基準。Score Bands: 5 (実務投入可能) ~ 1 (仕様言い換え)。Rubric: Coverage model (20), Observation quality (15), Risk quality (15), Manual cases (20), Exploratory charters (10), Gate decision (15), Communication (5)。Pass Rule: 合計 80点以上で pass, 70-79点は conditional pass, 69点以下は fail。Automatic Fail Conditions: coverage model なし, P0/P1 case に oracle refs なし, gate が coverage 数値だけで Go。
